title: A1 final
grammar: Revisão geral: to be x do, did + verbo normal, there is / there are, can, gonna (+ presente, continuous, direções e passado)
today: Hoje é o MEGA REAL TIME! A gente junta TUDO o que você aprendeu no A1: to be, presente, can, there is, gonna, o que está acontecendo agora e o passado. Se você chegou até aqui, você já conta fofoca em inglês. Falou, validou! 🚀
canDo: Escolher certo entre to be e do: Are you…? x Do you…?
Usar did + verbo normal: Did you get it back?
Dizer o que tem: There are loads of people
Pedir e dizer o que pode: Can I get off?
Contar planos com gonna e misturar tudo numa fofoca

video.context: A Beth conta um erro que ela cometeu numa viagem de trem de casa até Leeds, num dia em que o trem estava lotado.
video.predict: Antes de ouvir: o que você acha que a Beth esqueceu no trem? E será que ela conseguiu de volta?

options: She left her suitcase on the train

lines.text: Last Friday, Jenny went to Miami by train.
There were **loads of** people, and Jenny had a big red suitcase.
At 6:30, the train stopped in Miami.
Excuse me! Can I **get off**, please?
She got off the train. But her suitcase didn't!
She called Tony.
**Well**, my cousin works on that train. I'm gonna call him. He's gonna help you.
At 9, Tony's cousin came with the suitcase.
**So**, did you **get it back**, Jenny?
Yes, I did. Tony is the best!

options: Jenny's suitcase stayed on the train
The train didn't stop in Miami
Tony's cousin came with the suitcase

questions.q: What time did the train stop in Miami?

chunks.chunk: to be x do: Is…? / Does…?
chunks.tip: O ponto que mais trava no A1! Com lugar, idade, profissão, sentimento → to be (am/is/are). Com ação de rotina (work, live, like) → do/does. Nunca junte os dois: Are you work? ❌ → Do you work? ✅
examples: Is Jenny on the train? Yes, she is.
Does his cousin work on that train? Yes, he does.
Tony isn't on the train. He doesn't work there.

practice.pt: A sua prima trabalha no trem?
practice.en: Does your cousin work on the train?
alt: Does your cousin work on that train?

chunks.chunk: did + verbo normal: Did you get it back?
chunks.pt: Você pegou de volta? (passado com did)
chunks.tip: Get it back = pegar de volta. E a regra de ouro do passado: o did já carrega o passado, então o verbo volta ao normal. Did you got? ❌ → Did you get? ✅. She didn't got ❌ → She didn't get ✅.
examples: So, did you get it back, Jenny?
But her suitcase didn't get off!

practice.pt: O Tony não desceu do trem.
practice.en: Tony didn't get off the train
alt: Tony did not get off the train

chunks.chunk: there is / there are + loads of
chunks.tip: Loads of = um monte de (bem informal, nativo fala o tempo todo). Pra uma coisa: there is (there's). Pra várias: there are. No passado: there was / there were.
examples: There are loads of people on the train.
There is a big red suitcase on the train.

practice.pt: Tem um monte de gente no parque.
practice.en: There are loads of people in the park
alt: There are loads of people at the park

practice.pt: Tinha um monte de gente no trem.
practice.en: There were loads of people on the train

practice.pt: Tem uma mala vermelha no trem.
practice.en: There is a red suitcase on the train
alt: There's a red suitcase on the train

chunks.tip: Get off = descer (do trem, do ônibus). No passado: got off. E o can pra pedir com educação: Can I…, please? Vale pra qualquer pedido!
examples: Jenny had a big red suitcase.
Excuse me! Can I get off, please?

practice.pt: Com licença! Posso descer, por favor?
practice.en: Excuse me! Can I get off, please?
alt: Excuse me, can I get off, please?

practice.en: I got off the train at 7
alt: I got off the train at seven

chunks.chunk: I'm gonna… / He's gonna… / Are you gonna…?
chunks.pt: eu vou… / ele vai… / você vai…?
chunks.tip: Gonna é o futuro do dia a dia: am/is/are + gonna + verbo normal. Não esquece o to be! I gonna ❌ → I'm gonna ✅.
examples: Are you gonna get it back?

alt: I am going to call her
He is gonna help you tomorrow
He's going to help you tomorrow
He is going to help you tomorrow

practice.en: Are you gonna get it back?
alt: Are you going to get it back?

grammar.title: O mapa do A1
rows: I'm a nurse. / Are you OK?
eu sou enfermeira / você está bem? (to be)
I can swim. / Can I get off?
tem um monte de gente (there is/are)
I was tired. / Were you there?
eu estava cansado / você estava lá? (was/were)
grammar.tip: Pergunte pra frase: é AGORA? am/is/are + -ing. É SEMPRE/rotina? do/does. Foi ONTEM? -ed ou did. Vai ser AMANHÃ? gonna. Achou o tempo, achou a frase!

gossips.title: Left, Carlos, LEFT!

lines.text: Last Saturday was Carlos's birthday. He's 34 now.
Rosa had a surprise party for him at Lake Park. There were **loads of** people and a big cake.
At 4, Tony called Carlos.
Hey, Carlos! Can you come to Lake Park? Go straight ahead and turn right on Oak Street.
So Carlos turned right. Wrong way! At 5:15, Carlos called Tony.
Tony, where are you? I'm standing in front of a supermarket!
Oops! **My bad**. Left, Carlos, LEFT!
Finally, Carlos came at 6. And Max? He's eating the cake right now.

options: Carlos called Tony, and Tony said: left!

retell.prompt: Reconte a fofoca com as suas palavras. Comece com: "The story is about…"

gossips.title: Rosa's Day Off

lines.text: Rosa usually works every day. But last Wednesday was her **day off**.
She went to the movies at 2. Sam, 15, and Lily, 8, stayed home.
Mom, relax! I can cook. I'm gonna make pasta for dinner.
At 5, Rosa came back. There was pasta on the table, on the floor… and on Max!
What are you doing?!
**Well**, we're cooking dinner for you!
Rosa didn't get angry. Finally, they all went to a pizza place on Main Street. It was 30 dollars.

options: They went to a pizza place

questions.q: What time did Rosa come back?

realtimes.title: MEGA REAL TIME: Jenny
realtimes.pt: Oi! Meu nome é Jenny. Eu sou do Canadá, tenho 29 anos e sou enfermeira. Eu moro no apartamento 12 e trabalho de segunda a sexta. Eu sei nadar, mas eu não sei cozinhar. Ontem foi sábado: eu fui ao parque e vi o Max. Ele estava feliz! Agora eu estou estudando espanhol. Na semana que vem, eu vou viajar pra Miami.

Yesterday was Saturday: I went to the park and saw Max. He was happy! Now I'm studying Spanish. Next week, I'm gonna travel to Miami.

realtimes.title: MEGA REAL TIME: Where is Max?
realtimes.pt: Sabe o que aconteceu ontem no Sunset Building? O Max não estava no apartamento do Carlos! O Carlos procurou ele por 2 horas. Tem um parque perto do prédio. Ele foi até lá, virou à esquerda… e o Max estava lá, com o sanduíche do Tony! Agora o Tony não está feliz. Amanhã ele vai comprar um sanduíche novo.
